docs/index.md: the map of the bundle
docs/overview.md: what is declared once per cloud and per tenant user, and how a user's project comes and goes

docs/configuration.md: the values surface
docs/api.md: the resources rendered and generated, with their annotations
docs/examples.md: index of examples
docs/release.md: how a release ships
docs/log.md: history
examples/s2/README.md: the S2 verification setup
